latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of sticky-message-antipattern-detector.

- Audits drafts for eight specific stickiness-killing failure modes (anti-patterns) named in "Made to Stick"
- Produces a flagged-passage report: each instance located, severity-scored, and paired with a fix strategy
- Requires both draft text and audience profile as input; recommends context gathering if missing
- Designed for diagnosis (not end-to-end rewriting or full SUCCESs rubric scoring)
- Intended triggers include requests to diagnose, critique, or troubleshoot why a message, pitch, or announcement is not resonating
